title: Delivery & Pickup Services Fee Schedule: Reinstatement Fee on a Past-Due Delivery Pass
content:
The reinstatement fee of an overdue-cycle settlement on a Delivery & Pickup Services plan depends on the days past due. The reinstatement fee still due is added to the plan's subscription fee for the overdue cycle in the settlement.

## Schedule

| Days past due on the settlement date | Reinstatement fee |
|---|---|
| 8 or more | $4.00 |
| at least 4 but fewer than 8 | $2.00 |
| fewer than 4 | no reinstatement fee |

**Days past due** are the calendar days from the date the charge failed, as the plan's past-due date shows it, to the settlement date, the failure date not counted and the settlement date counted.

## Band edges (hypothetical: charge failed on 1 May)

| Settlement date | Days past due | Reinstatement fee |
|---|---|---|
| 4 May | 3 | none |
| 5 May | 4 | $2.00 |
| 8 May | 7 | $2.00 |
| 9 May | 8 | $4.00 |
| 15 May | 14 | $4.00 |

## Points of reference

**Is the failure date itself a day past due?** No. A settlement on the day the charge failed is 0 days past due.

**Does the fee rise again after 8 days?** No. From 8 days past due onward the fee is $4.00.
